metric.why: Capex is the audited ground truth beneath every buildout headline. This site reads it directly from EDGAR company facts, quarterly, for the hyperscalers and the largest colocation operators.
metric.definition: Quarterly capital spending reported to the SEC by the companies building the facilities, tracked on this page from each company's own XBRL filings.

reading.body:
Hyperscaler and colocation capital expenditure tracks quarterly capital spending reported to the SEC by the companies building data center facilities, read directly from each company's own XBRL filings.

This is described as the audited ground truth beneath every buildout headline, distinguishing it sharply from the construction-pipeline and rental-rate metrics elsewhere in this collection, which the site explicitly notes come from commercial research firms rather than audited filings. SEC EDGAR is named as the source, read quarterly for the hyperscalers and the largest colocation operators.

Its siblings, colocation rental rates and critical equipment lead times, are grouped under Financials and supply chain, and capex functions as the hardest, most verifiable data point in that cluster, the actual dollars spent rather than a market rate or forecast.
